fields.name: shop_id
fields.definition: Single approved store scope; same scope across independent inputs.

fields.name: publication_id
fields.definition: Selected immutable semantic publication vintage; all related facts and views use the same vintage.

fields.name: definition_version
fields.definition: Approved metric, calendar, eligibility and transformation contract version.

fields.name: readiness
fields.definition: Per-metric state: ready, pending, withheld or not_applicable. One ready sales metric does not certify spend/cohort/behavior.

fields.name: is_stale
fields.definition: True only for explicitly labeled last-good output retained after a failed/new pending candidate.

fields.name: report_date
fields.definition: America/New_York calendar date; ledger effective, cash settlement, order paid, first-customer paid and spend source-day inputs are separately aggregated onto this date.

fields.name: gross_merchandise_sales_usd
fields.definition: Sum eligible sales_ledger.amount_usd for merchandise_gross on ledger report_date. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: discounts_usd
fields.definition: Negative of sum eligible merchandise_discount ledger amounts on ledger report_date; positive normal discount magnitude, corrections may reverse. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: refunds_usd
fields.definition: Negative of sum eligible merchandise_refund ledger amounts on refund effective/report_date; merchandise only, signed corrections permitted. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: net_merchandise_sales_usd
fields.definition: Gross merchandise sales minus discount magnitude minus merchandise refund magnitude on ledger effective dates. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: shipping_net_usd
fields.definition: Signed eligible shipping_net ledger components. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: tax_net_usd
fields.definition: Signed eligible tax_net ledger components. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: duty_net_usd
fields.definition: Signed eligible duty_net ledger components. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: other_sales_adjustments_usd
fields.definition: Signed approved other_sales_adjustment ledger components; never fees or payment totals. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: total_sales_usd
fields.definition: Net merchandise + shipping net + tax net + duty net + approved other sales adjustments; explicit proposal, not presumed native Shopify metric parity. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: collected_cash_usd
fields.definition: Sum cash-eligible payments.cash_amount_usd on payments.report_date, independently aggregated. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: eligible_orders
fields.definition: Count distinct eligible orders.order_id on orders.purchase_date, including approved renewal classes; source purchase counts, not event counts. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: purchase_merchandise_net_usd
fields.definition: Sum qualifying orders.purchase_merchandise_net_usd on orders.purchase_date; no later refunds. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: new_customers
fields.definition: Count canonical customers once on customers.acquisition_date, with identity permission and complete first-order history. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: spend_usd
fields.definition: Total complete independently expected authorized base daily spend on the same New York calendar date. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: ncac_usd
fields.definition: spend_usd / new_customers; zero denominator gives null. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: mer
fields.definition: net_merchandise_sales_usd / spend_usd over same calendar scope; ledger refunds remain on their effective dates; zero spend gives null. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: aov_usd
fields.definition: purchase_merchandise_net_usd / eligible_orders; original discounted merchandise purchase value, not ledger-net-after-refunds AOV; zero orders gives null. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: report_date
fields.definition: Attributed order conversion_date (= New York paid_at date) and same-day ad-account spend date; NOT acquisition-session entry date or ledger refund date.

fields.name: channel
fields.definition: Approved acquisition/spend channel mapping, including distinct unattributed/not_applicable/unknown buckets.

fields.name: campaign_bucket
fields.definition: Qualified campaign key when mapped, else controlled non-null bucket (unattributed, not_applicable, no_campaign or spend_unallocated); no invented campaign IDs.

fields.name: model_version
fields.definition: Exactly one approved single-touch model.

fields.name: attributed_purchase_merchandise_net_usd
fields.definition: Sum orders.purchase_merchandise_net_usd × order_attribution.credit_weight for eligible orders in the selected bucket/model/publication. Retain unattributed/not_applicable buckets as diagnostic purchase value; ROAS applies only to approved applicable comparison scope. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: credited_orders
fields.definition: Sum single-touch credit_weight for eligible orders in the selected bucket, including explicit diagnostic unassigned/not_applicable rows; v1 weights are 1. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: weighted_new_customers
fields.definition: Sum credit_weight only for each permitted history-complete customer's first_eligible_order_id, once. Later orders never add another new customer. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: spend_usd
fields.definition: Independently summed base spend at compatible campaign/channel/date. Null for attribution buckets with no meaningful spend counterpart; known zero requires source coverage. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: first_party_roas
fields.definition: attributed_purchase_merchandise_net_usd / spend_usd for approved matched comparison scope only; zero/missing spend gives null. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: ncac_usd
fields.definition: spend_usd / weighted_new_customers for approved matched comparison scope only; zero or incomplete customers gives null. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: report_date
fields.definition: Units use orders.purchase_date; ledger sales/refunds use their own effective/report_date. The clocks are labeled, not treated as identical purchase cohorts.

fields.name: sku_bucket
fields.definition: Purchase-time order_items.sku or explicit unknown SKU bucket; never inferred from event context.

fields.name: units
fields.definition: Sum eligible merchandise order_items.quantity on parent purchase_date, before later returns. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: gross_merchandise_sales_usd
fields.definition: Sum allocated eligible merchandise_gross ledger amounts on effective date. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: discounts_usd
fields.definition: Negative of allocated eligible merchandise_discount ledger amounts on effective date. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: refunds_usd
fields.definition: Negative of allocated eligible merchandise_refund ledger amounts on refund effective date, net of original discount already reflected in the refund. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: net_merchandise_sales_usd
fields.definition: Allocated merchandise gross minus discount and merchandise refund magnitudes on each movement's effective date. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.definition: Single approved store scope; same scope across independent inputs.

fields.name: readiness
fields.definition: Per-metric state: ready, pending, withheld or not_applicable. One ready sales metric does not certify spend/cohort/behavior.

fields.name: is_stale
fields.definition: True only for explicitly labeled last-good output retained after a failed/new pending candidate.

fields.name: cohort_month
fields.definition: First day of New York month containing customers.acquisition_date; assigned once at customer level.

fields.name: observation_age_days
fields.definition: Common nonnegative follow-up horizon H days measured from each customer's first_eligible_order_at, not days since report generation.

fields.name: acquisition_definition_version
fields.definition: Approved first eligible paid order, identity and cohort rules; not a marketing attribution-model switch.

fields.name: as_of_at
fields.definition: Publication cutoff through which all required source facts/refunds and grace are complete.

fields.name: mature
fields.definition: Every included first-order cohort member has reached first_eligible_order_at + H days plus approved grace, with full required source history; incomplete cohorts withheld rather than survivor-selected.

fields.name: cohort_customers
fields.definition: Count distinct permitted history-certified canonical customers assigned to the full acquisition month; denominator held fixed for a publication and cohort definition. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: repeat_customers
fields.definition: Distinct cohort customers with at least one additional eligible order beyond first_eligible_order_id, with paid_at in [first_eligible_order_at, first_eligible_order_at + H days); multiple repeat orders count once. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: observed_net_merchandise_sales_usd
fields.definition: Select cohort customers' eligible orders with paid_at in [first_eligible_order_at, first_eligible_order_at + H days). Include each selected order's original merchandise sale and discount ledger components once, even if their source effective_at precedes payment/cohort start; include its eligible post-purchase merchandise adjustments/refunds effective before that H-day endpoint. Require original-versus-adjustment classification and source lineage. Never also add the purchase snapshot. Exclude refunds effective at or after the endpoint. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: repeat_purchase_rate
fields.definition: repeat_customers / cohort_customers when the entire requested cohort age is mature; zero denominator gives null. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: revenue_ltv_usd
fields.definition: observed_net_merchandise_sales_usd / cohort_customers at explicit mature H-day age, complete history and one as-of publication. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: report_date
fields.definition: America/New_York sessions.report_date (entry-date cohort), never order conversion date.

fields.name: stage_id
fields.definition: Approved stage key in sessions.funnel_flags, plus reserved all_sessions row; stage reach is not necessarily sequential.

fields.name: funnel_version
fields.definition: Approved stage, event-family and behavioral eligibility definitions.

fields.name: measured_sessions
fields.definition: Count distinct analytics-eligible, behavior-complete sessions for this stage; all_sessions is whole measured denominator. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: stage_reached_sessions
fields.definition: Count distinct eligible behavior-complete sessions whose approved stage flag is true; for all_sessions equals measured_sessions. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: mature_sessions
fields.definition: Count distinct stage-population sessions with behavior_complete and conversion_window_complete; explicit denominator for conversion. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: converted_sessions
fields.definition: Count distinct sessions in the same mature stage population with converted_session=true; multiple orders count once. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

fields.name: session_conversion_rate
fields.definition: converted_sessions / mature_sessions at selected stage; zero denominator gives null. Core store-level session conversion uses stage_id=all_sessions. Null when this metric's gates fail; zero only after complete evidence.

joins.conditions: Same selected immutable publication_id; select relevant definition/version before joining. LEFT lookup; null customer_id is valid and retained. Non-null keys must resolve; only permitted unambiguous identity supports customer metrics.
joins.risk: Inner join drops anonymous/unresolved commerce or visits; guessing a customer contaminates first-order cohorts.

joins.cardinality: Many selected mappings to at most one customer
joins.conditions: Same selected immutable publication_id; select relevant definition/version before joining. Before use select mapping_version and one valid interval per namespaced identifier; resolved/permitted/active only. Null unresolved mappings remain diagnostics.
joins.risk: Joining all intervals/versions or all identifiers fans out customers and events.

joins.cardinality: Many events to at most one selected mapping
joins.conditions: Same selected immutable publication_id; select relevant definition/version before joining. LEFT conditional lookup, with occurred_at >= valid_from and (valid_to is null or occurred_at < valid_to); one approved mapping_version, resolved/permitted/active only. Null distinct_id gives no match; overlapping/conflicting candidates produce unresolved null, not arbitrary selection.
joins.risk: Raw identity_map is interval/version grain, not unique on bare identifier; equality join alone is unsafe.

joins.cardinality: One customer to zero or one first order
joins.conditions: Same selected immutable publication_id; select relevant definition/version before joining. LEFT lookup; nullable until history_complete and permitted canonical identity. Matched order.customer_id must equal customer.customer_id; select earliest approved paid order over full history.
joins.risk: A minimum order only inside report dates falsely labels returning customers new.

joins.cardinality: Many to at most one
joins.conditions: Same selected immutable publication_id; select relevant definition/version before joining. LEFT lookup, scoped/versioned session_key; null event session remains visible. Build final diagnostic view after session derivation from normalized base.
joins.risk: Timestamp inference invents visits; publishing a circular session/event dependency fails.

joins.cardinality: Many orders to at most one checkout session; reverse one session to zero/many orders
joins.conditions: Same selected immutable publication_id; select relevant definition/version before joining. LEFT lookup; require checkout_link_status=matched and deterministic approved evidence for non-null link. Null missing/pending/conflicting/not_applicable orders remain.
joins.risk: Assuming one order per session overcounts conversion or drops sales; checkout context is not acquisition attribution.

joins.cardinality: Many actions to at most one order
joins.conditions: Same selected immutable publication_id; select relevant definition/version before joining. LEFT diagnostic lookup or distinct-key semijoin; validated shop-qualified non-null keys only. Null order links retained.
joins.risk: Summing a repeated order value per event multiplies revenue; purchase events cannot establish financial truth.

joins.cardinality: Many publication occurrences to one representative native record in fixed project scope
joins.conditions: Read-only lineage lookup in exactly the PostHog project identified by normalization/source configuration; native uuid uniqueness verified. Native records have no proposed publication_id. Retention may remove raw evidence, which must be reported as unavailable, not recreated.
joins.risk: Bare UUID across projects or native retries mistaken for canonical actions; native types/receipt fields are not certified.

joins.cardinality: Many to one
joins.conditions: Same selected immutable publication_id; select relevant definition/version before joining. Required parent must resolve; quarantine invalid rows and fail affected coverage rather than silently dropping them. Aggregate each child independently to required order/date grain before combining child measures.
joins.risk: Raw items × ledger × payments Cartesian multiplication; amounts have different clocks and meanings.

joins.cardinality: Many allocated components to at most one line
joins.conditions: Same selected immutable publication_id; select relevant definition/version before joining. LEFT lookup; non-null line must belong to the same order_id. Product metrics require product_allocation_status=allocated and complete eligible merchandise allocation; null order-level/unresolved rows stay in store totals. Refunds use ledger effective/report_date.
joins.risk: Dropping null allocations understates store sales; guessed refund allocation corrupts SKU sales; repeated purchase snapshot sums across movements overcount units.

joins.cardinality: Many offer memberships to one purchased line
joins.conditions: Same selected immutable publication_id; select relevant definition/version before joining. Required parent; reporting uses a DISTINCT order_item_id EXISTS/semijoin for a selected offer set, then sums each selected line/ledger slice once. No exclusive allocation is defined.
joins.risk: Offers overlap and slices are nonadditive; ordinary many-offer join multiplies line sales.

joins.cardinality: Many correction references to at most one original component
joins.conditions: Same selected immutable publication_id; select relevant definition/version before joining. Nullable reference; resolve to original movement slice with coherent component/order/currency. Diagnostic relation only; no summing both sides as new independent sales.
joins.risk: Counting correction plus original as two positive movements or also classifying reversal as another refund.

joins.cardinality: Many child transactions to at most one parent transaction
joins.conditions: Same selected immutable publication_id; select relevant definition/version before joining. Nullable source-provided parent link; order/currency compatibility required. Aggregate signed eligible cash transaction rows once; parent lookup is diagnostic.
joins.risk: Counting authorizations plus captures or parent capture repeatedly for each refund.

joins.cardinality: One to one over eligible orders within one model/publication
joins.conditions: Same selected immutable publication_id; select relevant definition/version before joining. Exactly one selected model_version; every eligible order receives one row including unattributed/not_applicable. Required order resolves; paid_at matches conversion basis. Weighted first customer uses only customers.first_eligible_order_id.
joins.risk: Multiple model/publication rows multiply sales; counting all customer orders multiplies acquisition denominators.

joins.cardinality: Many order credits to at most one acquisition session
joins.conditions: Same selected immutable publication_id; select relevant definition/version before joining. LEFT lookup at exactly one model_version; nullable for unassigned/not_applicable. Deterministic permitted customer link, approved pre-conversion window and eligibility required; session may differ from checkout_session_key.
joins.risk: Checkout/acquisition conflation and after-conversion touches fabricate attribution.

joins.cardinality: Many credits to at most one optional canonical touch
joins.conditions: Same selected immutable publication_id; select relevant definition/version before joining. LEFT lookup at one model_version; null optional touch retained. Non-null touch requires non-null acquisition_session_key equal to analytics_events.session_key and approved in-window eligible event evidence.
joins.risk: An arbitrary event from another visit or raw duplicate cannot certify the selected acquisition touch.

joins.cardinality: One reporting row to at most one independently prepared compatible campaign/day spend aggregate
joins.conditions: Same selected immutable publication_id; select relevant definition/version before joining. Approved comparison/lineage route only: first select one acquisition model/definition and one provider base_report_id, externally approved shop/account scope, USD and America/New_York day. Independently aggregate spend to campaign_key/report_date/publication and verify uniqueness before alignment. Match only qualified campaign buckets with consistent channel mapping. Keep unassigned/not_applicable/no_campaign rows with null denominator; use the independently expected calendar/scope to retain spend-only dates/campaigns. Never join daily spend directly to orders, customers, sessions or raw attribution rows.
joins.risk: Raw base reports, multiple models, or unmatched campaign labels can multiply/misallocate spend. This is a guarded aggregate-construction/lineage relation, not permission to re-add spend to already aggregated view measures.

joins.cardinality: OPTIONAL many to at most one
joins.conditions: Same selected immutable publication_id; select relevant definition/version before joining. Not implemented; nullable deterministic customer link only after optional module approval.
joins.risk: Optional outline does not establish churn, MRR or customer history completeness.

joins.cardinality: OPTIONAL many to one
joins.conditions: Same selected immutable publication_id; select relevant definition/version before joining. Not implemented; required source contract reference must resolve after optional module approval.
joins.risk: Migration, prepaid terms and lifecycle deduplication remain unresolved.

joins.cardinality: OPTIONAL provisional many to at most one; must be confirmed
joins.conditions: Same selected immutable publication_id; select relevant definition/version before joining. Not implemented; nullable only when a verified source-generated order exists. No money measures imported from the outline; validate one-obligation-to-order assumptions before implementing.
joins.risk: Retries, grouped billing or split orders may require a different optional grain; never multiply independent order sales.
